note: Staging plan for fully regenerated playable artwork. Rectangles are [x,y,width,height] in tiles; feet use tile centers. All images are style references only. No baked UI or direction labels.

districts.name: Central Exchange
districts.theme: Central civic finance plaza; amber gold financial architecture, dark steel, grey ground. Large central bank in the north, a circular raid gathering plaza, race console in west, checkout in east, leaderboard in south.

districts.name: Tech Quarter
districts.theme: Computing campus, electric blue accents, readable circuit details only on buildings. Two server facilities north, central job board, CP lab southwest, debugging lab southeast, small logic training console south of the main street.

districts.name: Data Harbor
districts.theme: Working data port, teal/cyan highlights, north/east docks visible outside the street grid, boats and cranes ONLY inside water/plot zones. Job board northwest, data centre north-middle, network tower northeast, OSINT southwest, SQL south-middle.

districts.name: Black Grid
districts.theme: Cybersecurity district, dark charcoal steel, restrained crimson lighting. Job board northwest, security hub with jail holding annex north-middle, simulated CTF arena northeast, challenge terminal southwest, safe sandbox lab southeast. No real weapons or combat.

districts.name: Undercity
districts.theme: Residential district center; amber domestic light, dark steel low-rise houses, sparse magenta signs without letters. Residential street junctions lead south to six housing wards. Information kiosk north-middle, local market southeast; decorative residential home clusters northwest, northeast, southwest. Clean usable streets, no invented economy facilities.

districts.name: NEXUS Plaza
districts.theme: Public city intelligence plaza; violet and blue highlights, holographic globe ON the north-center tower. Golden Hour terminal southwest, event terminal southeast, announcement screen northwest, social hub northeast, information terminal south-middle. A small fountain in central plaza with generous circulation around it.

connectors.name: Exchange ↔ Tech
connectors.theme: Amber finance architecture on east fades to blue technology on west; a broad pedestrian bridge over a thin canal, benches, food stall, vending machine, a small info kiosk in side plots.

connectors.name: Exchange ↔ Harbor
connectors.theme: Amber city steps south, teal cargo docks north; a straight broad stone pedestrian bridge across a horizontal harbor canal, dock cranes/boats strictly off the road, rest area, small information kiosk.

connectors.name: Exchange ↔ Black Grid
connectors.theme: Amber city on west, crimson cybersecurity on east; open security checkpoint arches spanning road without blocking it, surveillance towers in side plots, side rest area, food stall, info kiosk.

connectors.name: Exchange ↔ Undercity
connectors.theme: Amber city north, cozy magenta residential south; wide straight pedestrian ramp and steps over narrow horizontal canal, street market, small rest area and info kiosk in side plots.

connectors.name: Exchange ↔ NEXUS
connectors.theme: Violet NEXUS plaza entrance on west, amber Central Exchange on east; wide promenade with side fountains and holographic billboards entirely in side plots, rest bench, food stall and info kiosk.

connectors.name: Tech ↔ Harbor
connectors.theme: Blue server campus west, teal cargo pier east, broad uninterrupted pedestrian bridge across thin vertical canal, small information kiosk, rest area, food stall in side plots.

connectors.name: Undercity ↔ Black Grid
connectors.theme: Amber-magenta residential west to crimson security east; broad uninterrupted promenade, side gardens/ponds bounded by low walls, rest area, info kiosk, vending machine away from walking lanes.
